title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
teachers:
KIMURA Sadao
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this subject, students consider their career paths by clarifying their work objectives. In order to find their paths, students conduct industry and company research, and undertake self-analysis to understand their circumstances. In addition, students will acquire basic business and communication skills for job hunting.
advice:
This class is provided for 3rd-year students. The overview is as follows:

1.	Dialogue and opinion exchange with graduates
2.	Explanation of summer internships　
3.	Explanation of qualification examinations　
4.	Career design

Precautions
 The lectures described above are delivered as special lectures by invited graduates.
 Students are required to actively participate in class.
 The special lecture schedule is subject to change.
 Reference documents and practice problems will be distributed to students as appropriate.

requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminars I and II are courses for job hunting, and students will prepare for better employment. achievementLevels.ideal: Students with ideal achievement acquire the four target abilities. Also, they can judge a company's performance accurately not only from general articles but also from published IR data.
achievementLevels.standard: Students with standard achievement acquire about 75% of the four target abilities. Also, they can judge a company's performance from general articles in economic magazines or newspapers.

              In this subject, students consider their career paths by clarifying their work objectives. In order to find their paths, students conduct industry and company research, and undertake self-analysis to understand their circumstances. In addition, students will acquire basic business and communication skills for job hunting.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This class is provided for 3rd-year students. The overview is as follows:

1.	Dialogue and opinion exchange with graduates
2.	Explanation of summer internships　
3.	Explanation of qualification examinations　
4.	Career design

Precautions
 The lectures described above are delivered as special lectures by invited graduates.
 Students are required to actively participate in class.
 The special lecture schedule is subject to change.
 Reference documents and practice problems will be distributed to students as appropriate.
